entities.name: The Myths of Magic
entities.description: A Magic anthology of origin stories published in June 2000, edited by Jess Lebow.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane whose mysteries the stories explain.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria
entities.description: The invasion during which several of the stories are set.

entities.name: Godwyn
entities.description: A scholar captured by Phyrexians and compleated, who led a conquest of New Argive before being killed by Kari.

entities.name: Kari
entities.description: Compleated second-in-command of Godwyn who betrays and kills him.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Phyrexian lord whose myths are told to Godwyn.

entities.name: Ferric
entities.description: A ropemaker who tells of the creation of the Null Moon.

entities.name: Sirimiti
entities.description: Sorceress in Ferric's story.

entities.name: Tosel
entities.description: A pirate who wants to rescue a man on a raft.

entities.name: Daltran
entities.description: A pirate who warns Tosel with a story.

entities.name: Necros
entities.description: Creator of Night, Sleep and Death in assassins' myths.

entities.name: Astor
entities.description: A Keldon runner undergoing a trial to become a warlord.

entities.name: Kradak
entities.description: First doyen of Keld who learned fire magic.

entities.name: Jezal
entities.description: First doyenne who established Keld's rules of society.

entities.name: Dawar
entities.description: Otarian dwarf who tells of the making of Dominaria.

entities.name: Lyrin
entities.description: Dawar's great-granddaughter.

entities.name: Gaea
entities.description: God-sibling who creates life and land on Dominaria.

entities.name: Fiers
entities.description: God-sibling who creates life and land on Dominaria.

entities.name: Athanasia
entities.description: Woman who learned to outrun death.

entities.name: Pakihim
entities.description: Boy told a moral story by his grandfather Arkol.

entities.name: Arkol
entities.description: Pakihim's grandfather.

entities.name: Sabul Hajeen
entities.description: Faces the Hand of Justice in Arkol's story.

entities.name: Jhossendea Ilmiera
entities.description: Arch-enemy of Sabul's family who works with him.

entities.name: Iachem-oath
entities.description: God of all in Mercadian myth, husband of Arabeka.

entities.name: Arabeka
entities.description: Wife of Iachem-oath.

events.summary: Ferric tells his apprentice a fictional story of how the Null Moon was created.
events.quote: The ropemaker Ferric tells a story to his apprentice about how the Null Moon was created.

events.summary: Pirate Daltran stops Tosel from rescuing a man on a raft with a story about the witch of Tyree's blood-curse.
events.quote: but is stopped by another pirate, Daltran

events.summary: Godwyn is captured by Phyrexians, compleated, and leads a conquest of New Argive until Kari betrays and kills him.
events.quote: until he is betrayed and killed by his second-in-command, the Compleated woman Kari .

events.summary: Assassins of Janar tell myths of Necros, Deathbringer, creator of Night, Sleep and Death.
events.quote: tell myths of the origins of Night, Sleep, and Death, all created by Necros , the Deathbringer.

events.summary: Astor learns the foundation myths of Keld during his trial to become a warlord.
events.quote: as the Keldon runner Astor undergoes a trial to become a warlord

events.summary: Dawar tells Lyrin the story of the making of Dominaria by Gaea and Fiers.
events.quote: The Otarian dwarf Dawar tells the story of the making of Dominaria to his great-grand daughter Lyrin .

events.summary: During the Phyrexian Invasion, Benalish soldiers are told the story of Athanasia.
events.quote: one scared and one dying Benalish soldier are told a story about Athanasia

events.summary: Arkol tells Pakihim of Sabul Hajeen and the Hand of Justice in Ki'pamu.
events.quote: Sabul finds he has to work together with his family's arch-enemy Jhossendea Ilmiera to stop the avatar

relations.quote: until he is betrayed and killed by his second-in-command, the Compleated woman Kari .
